scope: One existing Chrome tab; local unsigned consent already checked, then human site-connected wallet switch. UI permission checks, not an executed contract call.

inputs.question: How long do I have to request a refund?
inputs.draft: Refund requests must be submitted within 14 days of purchase.
inputs.consent_label: I checked the content and agree to publish it.
inputs.consent_checked_by: assistant, only in the local unsigned confirmation
inputs.account_switched_by: human via MetaMask, as instructed; observed through the resulting ReplyCheck UI

sequence_notes: The first human 'done' was not accepted as a pass: two subsequent observations still showed B and checked consent. Both observations remain preserved.

After the next human 'done', the first fresh snapshot showed A as visitor, no confirmation and no answer-card approval control. The agent did not cancel, reload or navigate between the checked-confirmation and post-switch observations.
After recording the post-switch state, the agent inspected Team, temporarily entered the known public valid fixture, inspected references/cards, cleared only that test draft, and restored History.

Observation times are browser-check wall-clock timestamps. The displayed existing review time, 2026-09-12 15:03:29 UTC, is retained as UI-rendered historical evidence, not the account-switch time or a new chain timestamp.

checks.claim: Owner B can stage the existing matching-v2 answer-card confirmation; unchecked consent disables wallet continuation.
Checking local consent enables Continue to wallet without activating it.
After the human site-account switch, A is visitor and the checked confirmation and owner-only approval control are absent.
A valid public draft remains denied for A with the invitation-required message.
Team shows B as owner and A as visitor without management action controls.
Current v2 references remain readable without Edit references; two public cards remain readable without retirement controls.
The same ten history entries and current assessment remain visible; no approval, confirmation or recovery warning remains.
Temporary known test inputs are cleared and History is restored; no new wallet operation is staged.

output_payload.reason_code_scope: No contract execution was requested. Do not invent a contract reason code for UI permission gating.
output_payload.visitor_ui_reason: Ask the owner to invite this wallet, then accept in Team.

limitations: No continuous recording of the human MetaMask interaction interval; account identity and permission results are observed in the application's UI.
Current local source hashes were verified against the prior hash-pinned build. No fresh deployed-source RPC or full-state comparison was performed for this unsigned UI-only case.
This is not a two-tab checked-consent test, a network-change test, a pending-transaction identity test, a signing test, an actual simultaneous-send race or a forbidden contract-call execution.
Return-to-B consent reset remains a separate follow-up; public CI, native accessibility and full release gates remain open.
